question: 'Healthy air, Healthy Planet' was the theme of ____ 2021.

options.text: International Day Of Clean Air For Blue Skies

solution:
The correct answer is __**International Day Of Clean Air For Blue Skies.**____ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__

__
 
• “Healthy Air, Healthy Planet” is the theme for observance of the International Day of Clean Air for Blue Skies 2021.
 
• September 7 is celebrated annually as the International Day of Clean Air for Blue Skies.
 
• 2020 marked the first international observance of the Day with the theme “Clean Air for All.”
